svg.title: Galaxies receding as space expands
svg.desc: Galaxies scattered through space around the Milky Way (MW). Each has an arrow pointing directly away from the Milky Way, longer for more distant galaxies: recession speed is proportional to distance. An observer in any other galaxy would see the same pattern. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Expansion stretches galaxy separations and photon wavelengths
D = a χ; v = H D
Fixed galaxy sizes; growing unbound separations
Fixed comoving positions, scale factor 1 → 2. Arrows show recession with common H; the wave shows
wavelength stretching. No cosmic age scale or physical expansion center is implied.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
